name: Mixily
description_en:
Mixily creates event pages, sends invitations and collects RSVPs for hosted gatherings. Guests can reply without installing an app or creating an account. The official overview also describes reminders, guest questions, co-hosts, guest-list export and optional Google Calendar/Gmail connections.

Its limits distinguish invitations, accepted responses, active events and outgoing emails. Unlimited active events on the highest plan do not eliminate per-event guest limits or weekly email capacity. The direct HTML retrieved only an application shell, so this profile uses the actual public-web overview and the official pricing article rather than treating that shell as product evidence.
description_zh:
Mixily 用于创建活动页面、发送邀请和收集 RSVP，来宾无需安装应用或创建账户。官方概述还介绍提醒、来宾问题、联合主办、名单导出及可选 Google Calendar/Gmail 连接。

限制区分邀请、回答、活跃活动和发信量。最高套餐不限活跃活动，不表示每场人数或每周邮件不限。直接 HTML 只返回应用壳，因此本文依据实际公共网页概述和官方价格文章，不把壳页当产品证据。

core_features.explanation_en: Share an event page, invite guests and track replies without requiring guest accounts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分享页面、邀请和跟踪回复，无需来宾账户。

core_features.name_en: Capacity by events, guests and emails
core_features.name_zh: 按活动、来宾与邮件控制容量
core_features.explanation_en: Plans separately cap active events, invitations, RSVPs and weekly sends.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐分别限制活跃活动、邀请、RSVP 及每周发送。

en: Invite a community dinner guest list and track replies and reminders.
zh: 邀请社区晚餐名单，并跟踪回复及提醒。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Create a small event, test an RSVP change and export, then estimate invitations plus reminders against weekly capacity.
steps.zh: 创建小型活动，测试 RSVP 修改及导出，再按每周容量估算邀请加提醒。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Monthly plan by upcoming active events, per-event invitations/RSVPs and weekly email capacity.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free two active events/50 invites/40 RSVPs per event/200 weekly emails. Lite $19/month: five/100/100/1,000; Pro $29: ten/250/250/2,500; Plus $79: unlimited active events/1,500/1,500/5,000. Currency and current renewal/refund terms need confirmation. Cancellation preserves access until paid period end; downgrade contacts support.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费 2 活跃活动/每场 50 邀请/40 RSVP/每周 200 邮件。Lite 月 $19 为 5/100/100/1,000；Pro $29 为 10/250/250/2,500；Plus $79 为不限活动/1,500/1,500/5,000。币种及现行续费/退款需确认，取消保留至已付期末，降级联系支持。

sources.title: Mixily event pages and RSVP
sources.research_notes_en: Public web reader returned functional overview: event pages, RSVP, invitations, reminders, polling/custom questions, export and optional Google integrations. Direct HTML only returned a shell.

sources.title: Mixily Plans & Pricing: Free, Lite, Pro, and Plus
sources.research_notes_en: Official pricing article lists current Free/Lite/Pro/Plus limits, active-event definition, cancellation at period end and contact-required downgrade.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Define the guest list and invitation route
sections.en: For an illustrative community dinner, publish the event details, invite known guests and inspect RSVP answers before sending a reminder. The overview describes polls, custom questions and guest export, but does not establish sophisticated ticket payments, badge printing or academic review. Test a changed reply and export before relying on the list operationally. No invitation or message was sent in this research.
sections.zh: 例如社区晚餐，应发布详情、邀请已知来宾，检查 RSVP 后再提醒。概述介绍投票、自定义问题及名单导出，但不证明复杂售票、徽章或学术评审。运营使用前应测试回复变更与导出，本文未发送邀请或消息。

sections.title_en: Budget every reminder against email capacity
sections.title_zh: 把每次提醒计入邮件容量
sections.en: The official article lists Free with two active events, fifty invitations and forty RSVPs per event, and 200 emails weekly. Lite is $19/month with five events, 100 invitations/RSVPs and 1,000 weekly emails; Pro $29 with ten, 250 and 2,500; Plus $79 with unlimited active events, 1,500 per-event invitations/RSVPs and 5,000 weekly emails. Past events do not count as active. A large reminder run can reach the mail limit even while the event count is low.
sections.zh: 官方文章列 Free 为 2 活跃活动、每场 50 邀请/40 RSVP、每周 200 邮件；Lite 月 $19、5 活动、100 邀请/RSVP、周 1,000 邮件；Pro $29、10 活动、250 人及 2,500 邮件；Plus $79、不限活跃活动、每场 1,500 邀请/RSVP、周 5,000 邮件。过去活动不占活跃数，少量活动的大批提醒也可能触及邮件上限。

sections.title_en: Enable only the intended Google connection
sections.title_zh: 只启用需要的 Google 连接
sections.en: The public overview says Google sign-in is optional, Calendar connection adds hosted events to the host calendar, and Gmail send-only access sends invitations from the host address. It says the Gmail permission does not read or delete mail. Verify the actual consent screen and sending capacity before connecting; a platform description is not an independent permission audit. The current public overview identifies Nick Gray as operator, but contractual operator and historical migration details were not fully read.
sections.zh: 公共概述称 Google 登录可选，Calendar 连接把主办活动加入本人日历，Gmail 仅发送权限用于从主办人地址发邀请，说明不会读或删邮件。连接前需核对真实同意界面和容量，平台描述不是独立权限审计。现行概述标运营者为 Nick Gray，但合同主体和历史迁移细节未完整实读。

sections.title_en: Confirm current billing and data exit
sections.title_zh: 确认当前计费与数据退出
sections.en: The pricing article says cancellation keeps paid features until period end and downgrade requires contacting Mixily. Confirm currency, renewal, refunds and export/retention in current terms because the attempted terms page returned the same overview, not full terms. Mixily merits investigation for invitations and RSVP, not an assumed enterprise event stack. No self-hosted package, source license, Google consent flow, email delivery or RSVP export was tested or established.
sections.zh: 价格文章称取消后付费功能保留至账期结束，降级需联系 Mixily。尝试的条款页返回同一概述而非完整条款，因此币种、续费、退款及导出/保留仍需确认。邀请及 RSVP 可研究 Mixily，不能假定是企业活动全套。本次未测试或确认自托管、源码许可、Google 同意流程、邮件送达及 RSVP 导出。

research_gaps: Direct HTML and attempted terms page returned shells/overview; full current terms and operator-history details remain unverified.
No RSVP, export, Gmail/Calendar permission, delivery, paid upgrade or cancellation was tested.
Currency, renewal/refund, guest data retention, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
